caveats: Field presence/Serialize does not prove semantic durability.
UNKNOWN is not failure; it is an unresolved persistence disposition.
EPHEMERAL_CANDIDATE requires explicit acceptance before omission is considered safe.
Reproduced omissions are bound to recovery workflow candidates, not every future implementation.
ORACLE_PENDING means the semantic obligation is plausible enough to test but no pass/fail is assigned until candidate-bound execution.
